svg.title: Split attention and the combine step
svg.text: SplitAttentionKernel, then CombineSplitsKernel: one decode step, head 2
Layer 1 of Mei's chat: the new token "." at position 155 attends to 156 keys: SplitsFor(156) = 3 slices of 64.
grid = (num_kv_heads, BlocksPerSequence, batch); block (x, y, z) takes slices y, y + gridDim.y, … of sequence z.
BlocksPerSequence = ⌈80 SMs × 8 / (batch × 2)⌉, at most SplitsFor(4096) = 64: 64 for batch 1, 5 for batch 64.
Each block scores query heads 0–5 together (they share kv_head 0), reading each key once. Shown: head 2.
CombineSplitsKernel, block (head 2, sequence 0): thread s reads slice s
block y walks slices y, y + gridDim.y, …; each slice is keys [slice · 64, slice · 64 + 64)
the slice's own max and sum of e^(s − max_s)
partial output Σ e^(s − max_s) · v, its max and its sum, stored per slice
combine: overall max, rescale each slice, one weight per slice
thread d sums weights[t] · partial_t[d] over the slices
